scripts.dev: npm run db:wait && concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev:worker --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run db:wait && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.dev:worker: npm run db:wait && npm run dev:worker --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace backend && npm run check --workspace frontend
scripts.ci:check: npm run check:ci --workspace backend && npm run check --workspace frontend
scripts.ci:build: npm run build:ci --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
